The account `@0xPiracyData` accuses `@vsadkovv` (Vladimir Sadkov) and an alleged brother (Vladislav Sadkov / `vvsadkov`) of being "serial scammers," claiming the brother previously launched and rug-pulled a project called Xyro. It tags exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX) and on-chain investigators (ZachXBT, hrithikk), calling on them to help expose the accused. A price chart showing a collapsed token (~$0.07) is attached as evidence. Bottom line: these are one person's unverified allegations, not established facts.
